# `tool-shadowing`

**Page rule** · `error` · on by default

Two tools whose names read alike, registered from different frames, origins or scripts: an agent choosing between them is choosing by a difference it cannot see.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Options

| Option      | Default |
| ----------- | ------- |
| `minLength` | `4`     |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-shadowing": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-shadowing": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-shadowing": { minLength: 4 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule tool-shadowing=off
```
